a.title: Saving plans
a.stem: Maya has $120 in savings and adds $15 each week. Leo has $40 and adds $25 each week.
parts: Write an expression for the amount Maya has after w weeks.
Write and solve an equation to find after how many weeks Maya and Leo have the same amount.
How much money does each person have at that time?
Write and solve an inequality to find the least whole number of weeks after which Leo has more than $300.

a.title: Markup, sale and tax
a.stem: A store buys a jacket for $48 and marks the price up 75%. Later the jacket is on sale for 20% off, and a 6.25% sales tax is added at the register.
parts: What is the selling price before the sale?
What is the sale price?
What is the total cost with tax?
By what percent is the total cost greater than the store’s cost of $48? Round to the nearest tenth of a percent.

b.title: Temperature changes
b.stem: At 6:00 a.m. the temperature was −9°F. It rose 4°F each hour until noon, then fell 3°F each hour until 4:00 p.m.
parts: What was the temperature at noon?
What was the temperature at 4:00 p.m.?
Write an expression using integers for the total change from 6:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., and evaluate it.
What is the difference between the highest and lowest temperatures of the day? Show it as the distance between two numbers on a number line.

b.title: A circular garden
b.stem: A circular garden has a radius of 6 feet. A path 2 feet wide goes around it. Use 3.14 for π.
parts: What is the area of the garden?
113.04 square feet
What is the area of the path alone?
87.92 square feet
Fencing goes around the outside edge of the path. How many feet of fencing are needed?
50.24 feet
On a scale drawing, 1 inch represents 4 feet. What is the diameter of the outside edge of the path on the drawing?
4 inches
